artwork.name: nice
artwork.label: 真不错！
artwork.palette: soft pastel mint green #A0E2C3 with aqua #8BD6CD
artwork.prompt: Use case: text-localization / production game sprite. Input is a style reference for glossy inflated letter material, not a layout to preserve. Create ONE standalone simplified Chinese encouragement word sprite with exact text "真不错！". One horizontal line, large very thick rounded bubbly Chinese strokes, accurate legible characters. Palette: soft pastel mint green #A0E2C3 with aqua #8BD6CD. REDUCE saturation to coordinate with a soft pastel mint/lavender/cream cat garden game. Broad soft white highlight, smooth rounded 3D jelly material, thick warm ivory #FFF2DA outline, shallow muted warm mauve #997A91 extrusion at lower-right. Delicate small cream-gold four-point sparkle on each outside end, only two. Center full composition with generous empty margins on a wide 3:1 canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background. Nothing behind the word. NO colored backdrop, vignette, gradient backdrop, floor, halo, shadow cloud, haze, noise, checkerboard painting, panel or other words. Edges must be crisp and clean, completely transparent outside the cream outline and tiny sparkles. This is a single game-ready sprite, not a poster. Entire word must fit without clipping.
